title: Blast Cascade
body:
Syntax: perform blast cascade <target>

Description: A Explosion Release attack that strikes one target. A stun briefly blocks the target's actions.  Requires Explosion Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 1509-1789. 35% chance to inflict stunned. Unlocks at level 70. Costs 78 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
